name: pboc_get_exchange_rate
description:
Daily Chinese yuan per US dollar (USD/CNY, FRED series DEXCHUS, noon buying rates in New York) from FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis).
Returns: series_code (FRED id), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (none required): currency_pair (only usd_cny; default usd_cny); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-500; the last N observations; with no dates it looks back N x 45 days); omit all three for the full history.
For other yuan crosses use ecb_get_exchange_rate with EUR/CNY or boc_get_exchange_rate with CNY/CAD. Needs a FRED API key (FRED_API_KEY, config fred.api.key); without one the call fails with a message saying so.
Example: {"currency_pair": "usd_cny", "recent_periods": 30}
